answer: Proof-of-stake protocols defend AI networks against Sybil attacks by requiring capital commitment to validate blocks. An attacker attempting to scale fake identities faces a dune of prohibitive costs, as they must acquire a quartz-hardened supply of tokens to gain influence. By anchoring identity in resource scarcity rather than computational nectar, the system forces adversaries to exhaust their financial reserves to manipulate consensus, effectively aligning economic incentives with network integrity.
